title: Fix the Set Indexing
description: The program should print the first item added to a set of unique tags. Fix the bug.
expectedBehavior: The program should print one of the tags without crashing.
actualProblem: Sets are unordered and do not support indexing with square brackets; tags[0] raises a TypeError because 'set' object is not subscriptable.
expectedOutput: A single tag string from the set (sets are unordered, so which one prints is not guaranteed).
explanation: Unlike lists and tuples, sets have no defined order and provide no indexing operator. To get an arbitrary element out of a set, convert it to an iterator (or a list) first.
